7090.title: Windows hosts cannot pass Browser Automation runtime preparation
7090.rootCauseOneLine: The host runtime platform enum and pinned artifacts exclude Windows; both desktop and local sessions require that runtime before opening.
7090.proposedFix: Ship and verify a Windows runtime through the packaging pipeline, or design a separate execution backend that preserves existing control boundaries. Neither qualifies as a simple fix.
7090.caveats: Exact host runtime guard reproduced twice on Linux with Windows platform descriptors; no native Windows desktop or end-to-end browser session was available. Existing tests: 68 passed. No production fix attempted.
